purpose: Source availability and lifecycle-state manifest only. It is not a licence to reproduce or bundle copyrighted textbook content.

status_definitions.CURRENT: Official source/current-use evidence is sufficient for source mapping.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Official availability exists, but exact title, edition, or full-set/current-use verification is incomplete.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Do not ingest or serve as textbook-grounded content until official source is verified.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED: Older source retained only for history; do not use for current tutoring.
status_definitions.RECALLED: Officially recalled/withdrawn; must not be ingested or served.

production_rules: Never infer CURRENT from mere online existence.
RECALLED and BLOCKED records are hard-deny for ingestion.
SUPERSEDED records are excluded from current routing.
Official textbook availability does not imply redistribution or reproduction permission.
Teacher-authored explanations/examples remain separate from copyrighted source text.
Classes 1-8 use NCERT / CBSE-aligned labeling; Classes 9-10 may use direct CBSE 2026-27 curriculum labeling.

official_public_evidence.note: 17-Mar-2026: new textbooks Grades 1-8 developed and available; Grade 10 existing textbooks continue in 2026-27.
01-May-2026: Grade 9 books released except Social Science.
24-Jun-2026: warns fake/unofficial Class IX Social Science Part 1 circulation.
Official CBSE curriculum 2026-27 for Classes IX-X.
09-Apr-2026: names Kaveri for Class IX English.
